messages:
lucas: heads up, saw a confusing pattern where overage spikes map to project B but traces show request originated from proj C.
maria: similar to earlier issues but maybe different cause? any recent proxy changes?
kevin: we rolled edge-async v2 last night. it introduced a non-blocking exchange call that leaves a provisional attribution until exchange callback.
rachel: provisional attribution meaning: proxy sets header `X-Auth-Attr: provisional=proj:C;req_id=xyz` and router uses it immediately.
ankur: problem: if the exchange callback arrives after routing we can't retroactively change the routed billing. router is stateless for cost reasons.
lucas: right. so proposals: 1) make attribution immutable at edge (no provisional), 2) make router consult exchange sync (slower), 3) attach a signed short-lived HMAC token and do reconciliation.
maria: option 1 breaks latency SLAs for startup requests. option 2 is bad during surge. I lean to 3.
kevin: HMAC token idea: edge includes `X-Auth-Proof: v1;id=xyz;hmac=...` where hmac = HMAC(k_current, req_id|proj|ts). Router charges provisional to org-pool and publishes event with proof.
ankur: later, exchange can emit final attribution event with same req_id and signed assertion. A reconciliation job consumes both and emits correction if needed.
billing-bot: note: billing rules require final charge to be applied within 24h and show audit trail. corrections must include original proof + final proof.
rachel: UX: console should display a small "provisional" flag on quota charts and a count of corrections. avoid surprising customers.
kevin: implement steps: A) edge signs HMAC and sets TTL 20s, B) router accepts provisional charge to org-pool and tags trace, C) exchange posts final assertion asynchronously, D) reconciliation emits correction events to billing and dashboard.
maria: security: who holds the signing key? KMS-managed per-region?
ankur: KMS per-region with key rotation. include kid header. sample header: ```
X-Auth-Proof: v1;id=xyz;kid=auth-reg-1;ts=1680000000;hmac=BASE64
```
kevin: replay protection: include req_id and short TTL; router should reject proof older than TTL.
lucas: telemetry: add spans: auth.proof.verify_ms, auth.provisional_charge_count, auth.corrections_emitted. Also add alert if corrections/requests > 0.001 for 10m.
billing-bot: create billing ticket BILL-412 for correction schema and GL mapping.
sre-bot: created infra task INF-901: "deploy HMAC verification in router" assigned @kevin.
rachel: concern: org-pool charging might be gamed. if many projects intentionally cause exchange delays, costs leak to org admins. mitigation: org admin permission to set org-pool caps and notifications.
maria: good point. console change: org settings -> "provisional charge cap" default to 5% of monthly commit.
ankur: rollout plan: start with read-only reconciliation (generate correction diffs but don't apply), run for 48h on internal orgs, then 1% external canary.
kevin: tests: unit for HMAC generation, integration with KMS rotate endpoint, e2e simulation with delayed exchange callback.
lucas: I've pushed a minimal RFC in PR #3847 describing header, TTL, reconciliation schema. please comment.
maria: thanks. action items: KEVIN implement router verify, ANKUR reconcile consumer read-only, RACHEL add console provisional badge + cap setting, LUCAS coordinate RFC.
rachel: also add docs snippet for SDK users: `client.setAuthProof(reqId)` example.
kavin: (typo) kevin: lol.
sre-bot: monitoring note: will add provisional_charge dashboard.
